title: First Deposit 37% Bonus — Fast Start
colorRevisionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, contrasting color art-direction revision.
Edit this exact First Deposit 37% Bonus campaign banner. The user dislikes the current overly uniform red/gold/amber color cast and has selected #597CFF ELECTRIC BLUE as the contrasting accent. This is a strong color-separation revision, not simply a blue glow added over the orange image.
Preserve the exact 1983 x 793 wide layout, gift-box geometry, open lid position, coin positions, Jito red-and-gold emblem, and all text content and placement.
NEW COLOR DISTRIBUTION:
- Background and reflective floor: cool deep charcoal/navy, approximately #10172C, with a sophisticated broad electric-blue #597CFF light field behind the gift. Remove the red/amber background wash and orange haze completely. Keep the left behind text particularly dark and calm.
- Replace the large gift ribbon and bow's yellow/gold satin with vivid satin ELECTRIC BLUE #597CFF, lit with lighter blue highlights and deep royal-blue folds. Retain only thin champagne-gold edge trims. The ribbon is a substantial contrasting blue color block, not a tiny accent.
- Gift box body remains rich BURGUNDY #681C32 / deep ruby red. Its original central red-and-gold Jito emblem remains unchanged and legible.
- Large "37%" faces remain luminous champagne gold with dimensional metallic bevels, but change its thick red extrusion/shadow edge to dark navy with narrow electric-blue rim reflections. 37% must remain the dominant large typographic anchor, with strong separation from background.
- "FIRST DEPOSIT" and "BONUS" retain their sculpted serif type and placement but use slightly paler, less saturated champagne-gold faces than 37%, with cool navy extrusion, to reduce the blanket yellow look. Subtitle stays soft warm ivory.
- The open-gift light spill becomes pale electric blue, no yellow-white blast. The curved light trail behind the gift is electric blue. Background bokeh becomes sparse dim blue-gray with only a couple subtle warm highlights. Keep a small quantity of warm gold coins and red rubies so they stand out against the cool blue environment.
Maintain premium polished cinematic 3D realism, crisp large shapes, simplified medium detail, clean readable type and natural material reflections. Reduce excessive small star sparkles. No people, no new objects, no culture-specific motifs.
EXACT TEXT, same sizes and locations:
"FIRST DEPOSIT"
"37%"
"BONUS"
"Start with more."
Do not change letters, spacing, scale or line breaks; do not cover text. No buttons, CTA, added labels, new amounts, borders or watermark.
Desired result: clearly separated cool blue background and ribbon, rich burgundy box, warm champagne-gold focal percentage. Not monochromatic red/gold, not teal, not turquoise, not pastel ice blue. #597CFF is the dominant contrasting hue. Full-bleed opaque 1983 x 793 artwork.
prompt:

Completely replace the gift/rewards subject in this First Deposit 37% Bonus banner with a MODERN CINEMATIC MOTORSPORT / FAST START theme. The user explicitly wants no gift boxes and no treasure chests. The accepted contrasting accent is ELECTRIC BLUE #597CFF. Image 1 provides the layout, exact lettering, and blue-versus-gold palette; Image 2 is the Jito brand emblem for a small badge.
Preserve the left-side text and typography exactly at the same positions and sizes:
"FIRST DEPOSIT"
"37%"
"BONUS"
"Start with more."
Keep the massive dimensional champagne-gold 37%, cool navy extrusion, pale champagne headings and warm ivory subtitle. Keep their legibility and safe margins. Do not alter, reflow, obscure or add any wording.
Replace EVERYTHING on the right half (gift, lid, bow, ribbons, floating coins, foreground coins, rubies) with ONE sleek original-design burgundy GT sports car, rendered in the same premium high-quality cinematic 3D game-campaign style. Low three-quarter front perspective, sculpted flowing bodywork, deep wine-red #681C32 paint, a few narrow champagne-gold trim details, dark bronze wheels and thin electric-blue edge reflections. Place the car solidly in the right foreground, diagonally facing slightly toward the viewer and center, with crisp body silhouette and realistic proportions. Keep enough margin to read the car, no silly deformation, no manufacturer logo or recognizable licensed car design. A tiny refined Jito red-and-gold emblem may appear naturally on the hood as a badge. No people.
Environment: a restrained futuristic racetrack / midnight racing tunnel, very softly blurred with strong depth, cool deep navy-charcoal atmosphere, #597CFF electric-blue lighting bars and sweeping blue speed trails leading toward the distant right. The road has subtle blue reflections and a few controlled motion streaks, the car remains sharp. Keep the left behind typography dark and quiet. Distinct wine-red car against blue background, warm typography against deep navy. Avoid white blasts, gold fog, amber background wash, neon cyan or teal. Do not add circular magical halos.
No gift boxes, treasure chests, bows, ribbons, coins, chips, gems, prizes, trophy props or extra ornaments anywhere. The car is an atmospheric racing motif that communicates a strong start, not advertised as a giveaway; do not include prize labels.
Modern dynamic luxury, clean larger shapes, medium detail, dramatic clean lighting, strong cold/warm contrast. Keep the scene visually simpler than the reference. No CTA, buttons, border, extra copy, cash amounts or watermark. Final static full-bleed opaque 1983 x 793 horizontal banner.
